title: A regularized truncated finite element method for degenerate parabolic stochastic PDE on non-compact graph
summary: We study the numerical approximation of a class of degenerate parabolic stochastic partial differential equations on non-compact metric graphs, which naturally arise in the asymptotic analysis of Hamiltonian flows under small noise perturbations. The numerical discretization of these equations faces several challenges, including the non-compactness of the graph, the degeneracy of the differential operator near vertices, and the non-symmetry of the associated bilinear form.
